method: Checked all 32 existing repository profiles first, using fresh official public documentation/HTML and pricing tables; Codex is an operator-disabled preference rather than a price policy. Search discovery followed validation. Published rates, schedules, eligibility and deadlines are compared with fetched origin/main. No account bill is verified. Twenty-five profiles are fully reverified, five partial, AIHubMix route-unverified and Codex disabled. Partial/unverified/disabled verifiedAt values remain unchanged. All implementation is isolated from the saved main checkout.
summary: Correct stale Baidu campaign titles/subtitles/kickers/product labels now that the October 7 offer expired; show standard API pricing and link to the official pricing document. Existing schedule logic already reverts correctly.

Describe Z.ai all-day and Flash campaign dates as historical. The usual weekday 14:00–18:00 Singapore peak quota rate resumes, with half quota outside that window. Preserve the historical ambiguous final-night interpretation without advertising an active campaign.

DeepSeek National Day off-peak exception ended October 7; peak resumes October 8. October 10 remains off-peak as a Saturday even though the government lists it as a makeup working day; the provider explicitly defines weekdays Monday–Friday.
No newly verified clock-compatible provider added; mode-based batch/flex pricing and policies missing a time zone are not turned into inferred clock windows.
No merge, push, deployment or server restart. Temporary worktree is removed after commit; branch preserved.
uncertainties: DeepSeek table still lists separate Pro 0813 pricing while its September 10 routing announcement says Pro requests route to Flash until a future V4.1 Pro launch; current Pro scope remains unverified.
AIHubMix aggregate schedule/rates differ from named routes and automatic fallback is documented; no universal schedule or weekend/holiday rule can be guaranteed.
Z.ai's expired Flash campaign did not specify the final October 7 overnight cutoff. Historical interpretation is retained, not newly certified.
Baidu's expired campaign and daily DeepSeek windows do not explicitly label a time zone in the checked sources; Beijing remains a visible assumption.
Tencent October 31 Flash 0731 retirement notice does not explicitly cover Vendor Direct; do not assume coverage.
SiliconFlow Hunyuan daily 09:00–18:00 price split lacks a confirmed time zone; no inferred provider added.
Swarms Black Friday free-request promotion lacks a published exact time-zone/start instant; not encoded.
Chinese holiday exceptions cover 2026 only. Do not infer them for other providers. No settled-account pricing verification performed.
